    // Every component scaled by a scalar, scalar on the left.
    Multiply(scalar: Number, right: Number2): Number2

    // Component-wise quotient. Precondition: no component of right is zero.
    Divide(left: Number2, right: Number2): Number2
        => (left.X / right.X, left.Y / right.Y);

    // Every component divided by a scalar. Precondition: scalar is non-zero.
    Divide(left: Number2, scalar: Number): Number2
        => (left.X / scalar, left.Y / scalar);

    // The tuple with every component negated.
    Negative(value: Number2): Number2
        => (-value.X, -value.Y);

    // The dot product: the sum of the products of corresponding components.
    Dot(self: Number2, right: Number2): Number
        => self.X * right.X + self.Y * right.Y;

    // Each component restricted to the corresponding [min, max] range.
    // Precondition: min <= max component-wise.
    Clamp(self: Number2, min: Number2, max: Number2): Number2
        => (self.X.Clamp(min.X, max.X), self.Y.Clamp(min.Y, max.Y));

    // The component-wise maximum.
    Max(self: Number2, value2: Number2): Number2

    // The component-wise minimum.
    Min(self: Number2, value2: Number2): Number2
        => (self.X.Min(value2.X), self.Y.Min(value2.Y));

    // The IHashable obligation: every component folded into one digest.
    Hash(self: Number2): Integer
        => self.X.Hash.CombineHash(self.Y.Hash);
